question: How do I apply a LUT to a clip in the Color page?
expected_answer: Go to Color page > open the LUT dropdown in the Color panel > select a LUT file (.cube) > it applies to the current node

question: What is the difference between the Cut page and the Edit page?
expected_answer: Cut page is for fast/rough editing with a simplified interface; Edit page is the full-featured timeline editor with more tools and tracks

question: How do I change the timeline resolution in DaVinci Resolve?
expected_answer: Project Settings > Timeline Resolution > select desired resolution (e.g. 1920x1080, 3840x2160)

question: What is the maximum number of video tracks in a timeline?
expected_answer: V1-V64 (64 video tracks) plus V1-V64 for Fusion comp tracks

question: How do I export a project as a ProRes 422 HQ file?
expected_answer: Deliver page > select QuickTime > codec ProRes 422 HQ > set filename > Add to Render Queue > Render All

question: What is the purpose of the Fairlight page in DaVinci Resolve?
expected_answer: Audio mixing and post-production: multi-track mixer, EQ, compression, reverb, automation, and audio export

question: How do I create a speed ramp (variable speed) on a clip?
expected_answer: Edit page > right-click clip > Speed Change > enable 'Retime and Slip' > add speed keyframes in the timeline

question: What is the difference between a node and a layer in the Color page?
expected_answer: Nodes are the building blocks of the color grading chain (serial/parallel); layers don't exist in Color — that's a Fusion concept. Nodes allow non-destructive grading with multiple passes

question: How do I add a title/caption to my video?
expected_answer: Edit page > Titles and Subtitles panel > drag a title (e.g. 'Caption') onto the timeline > double-click to edit text > style in Inspector

question: What is the maximum supported frame rate in DaVinci Resolve?
expected_answer: Up to 120 fps (varies by version and GPU; Resolve Studio supports higher rates than free version)

question: How do I stabilize a shaky clip in DaVinci Resolve?
expected_answer: Edit page > right-click clip > Open in Fusion > add 'Stabilizer' effect > adjust settings > render. Or: Color page > Open in Fusion > Stabilizer

question: What is the difference between DaVinci Resolve and DaVinci Resolve Studio?
expected_answer: Studio is the paid version: no watermark, higher export resolutions (4K+), GPU-accelerated noise reduction, advanced audio tools, multi-user collaboration, no frame rate limits

question: How do I apply a color correction wheel (lift/gamma/gain) to a clip?
expected_answer: Color page > select clip > use the Color Wheels in the primary color correction panel: Lift (shadows), Gamma (midtones), Gain (highlights)

question: What is the purpose of the 'Smart Reframe' feature?
expected_answer: Automatically reframes a video for different aspect ratios (e.g. 16:9 to 9:16 for social media) by tracking the main subject

question: How do I add a green screen key (chroma key) in DaVinci Resolve?
expected_answer: Fusion page > add 'Keyer' effect (e.g. Delta Keyer) > select the green color > adjust tolerance and spill suppression > composite over background

question: What is the maximum file size for a single clip in DaVinci Resolve?
expected_answer: Not specified in the manual — depends on available disk space and RAM. No hard limit documented.

question: How do I make a video loop in DaVinci Resolve?
expected_answer: Not a native feature. Workaround: duplicate clips on timeline or use Fusion with a loop node. The manual does not describe a built-in loop function.

question: What is the keyboard shortcut to split a clip at the playhead?
expected_answer: B (Blade edit) — splits the clip under the playhead on the current track
